# Preschool Connect Copilot instructions

For work in this standalone PreschoolConnect folder, follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and load only task-relevant project docs. Preserve the separate Personal Finance Tracker and its local data. Use synthetic student data; enforce school/student authorization server-side; do not assume proposals are approved. Research licenses and dependency security before adoption. Do not install system software, commit, or deploy unless requested.
